findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered without a React key in filtered rule list
findings.body: In the `rules.map(...)` switch, the `case 'grafana'` branch now renders `<GrafanaRuleListItem rule={...} ... />` without the `key={key}` prop that the previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` had (the `datasource` and `default` branches still pass `key`). Rendering list items without keys forces React to reconcile by position, which can mix up per-item state (open dropdowns, silence drawers, delete modals) between rules when the list updates during polling or infinite-scroll loading, and logs key warnings in development.

findings.title: Delete menu item never appears for rules loaded without the ruler API
findings.body: The Delete menu item is gated on `{canDelete && rulerRule && ...}`. The whole point of this PR is that the alert list view no longer fetches ruler data, so `RuleActionsButtons.V2`/`GrafanaRuleListItem` render the menu with `rulerRule` undefined and only `promRule` set. `canDelete` may be true via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, but the extra `rulerRule` presence check means the Delete option is always hidden in the list view, so users cannot delete Grafana-managed rules from the list even though the underlying `showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)` handler doesn't need the ruler rule.

findings.title: Pause menu item hidden in list view because it requires the ruler rule
findings.body: The pause item renders only when `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && groupIdentifier.groupOrigin === 'grafana'`. In the list view `rulerRule` is now always undefined (ruler requests were removed), so `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` is false and Pause/Resume never appears even when `canPause` is granted through the new `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` path. The `MenuItemPauseRule` component currently needs the ruler DTO, but as implemented the prom-rule pause ability added in this PR is dead code in the UI.

findings.title: Silence drawer cannot open from the list view without a ruler rule
findings.body: The silence drawer is rendered as `{rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer && (<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer rulerRule={rule} .../>)}`. In the list view only `promRule` is provided (`rule` is undefined), so clicking 'Silence notifications' in the menu sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true but the drawer never renders and nothing happens. The menu's Silence item can now be shown based on prom-rule abilities (`useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`), making this a user-visible no-op action.

findings.title: Rules being created no longer appear in the group view
findings.body: The previous implementation merged ruler rules with Prometheus rules and showed ruler-only rules with a 'Creating' state and prom-only rules with a 'Deleting' state. This PR drops the ruler fetch entirely and renders only `promResponse.data.groups.at(0)?.rules`. A newly created Grafana-managed rule is written to the ruler before it appears in the Prometheus-compatible endpoint, so during that window the rule is completely absent from the group list (and the `operation` prop on GrafanaRuleListItem is now never passed). Likewise a just-deleted rule vanishes immediately rather than showing 'Deleting'. If this temporary-inconsistency window is intentional, the removed behavior should be confirmed; otherwise users will see rules disappear/reappear with no indication.
